Apologies for the multiple copies of this email.

We would greatly appreciate your assistance in disseminating this announcement to potential applicants who have completed their Computer Science Ph.D.. (or equivalent) and are seeking a post-doctoral position.

La Rochelle University's Laboratory of Informatics Image Interaction (L3i -

This post-doctoral fellowship focuses on the following topic:

· Topic: "Sensitive document protection: contextual inference of document sensitivity levels through aggregation of sensitive intra-document information"

Successful applicants are expected to commence their research at the Lab. before the end of 2026.

Interested candidates should submit their CV and cover latters, along with a list of two references and transcripts, to Prof. Yacine GHAMRI-DOUDANE (

), with [Post-doc Application] as the email subject prefix (failure to include this prefix may result in the loss of your application). Applications will be accepted until September 15, 2026. Applications will be processed on a first come first serve basis, with first hearings starting on August 17, 2026.

Desired Skills:

· Highly valued and welcomed expertise in Data Science (Data Mining and Information Retrieval), Artificial Intelligence (Machine/Deep Learning. Agentic AI, LLMs / GenAI), Document Analysis.

· A solid understanding of Cyber Threat Intelligence and Cybersecurity.

· Proficient programming skills in various languages and software tools, such as Python, Java, C/C++, etc.

· Effective communication skills.

· Proficiency in both written and spoken English.
